expected_root_cause: The v1.3.0 deployment expected an available_stock field that is absent from the product-service response contract.
expected_symptoms: The order creation error rate steps up immediately after deployment.
Product-service calls succeed but order-service fails while processing their responses.
Successful requests return after the v1.3.1 rollback deployment.
expected_evidence: deployment_history.json records order-service v1.3.0 at 2026-09-20T10:00:00Z with commit 35e6df3.
order-service logs contain a KeyError for available_stock after the v1.3.0 deployment.
Prometheus order-service HTTP 5xx counters step up after deployment and recover after v1.3.1.
Jaeger traces show successful product dependency spans beneath failed order-service HTTP 500 spans.
expected_resolution: Roll back to the previous order-service version that reads the existing stock response field.

timeline.event: Capture the stable v1.2.0 order-service error rate and dependency latency.
Deploy order-service v1.3.0 with the incompatible product response contract.
Order creation errors and response-processing exceptions begin after deployment.
Roll back order-service and confirm successful dependency calls return.
